text:
maria: Heads up — we got the pen test report from the external team this morning. Quick skim shows 2 findings we should treat as blockers for public-facing traffic (KMS policy leakage + RBAC token swap). Planning a short dry-run/readroom + retest window. Who can help own evidence packaging and the KMS proxy? :wave:

jordan: On it. I pulled out the two high sev items: LATERAL-001 (KMS key policy allows cross-account decrypt via overly-broad condition) and ELEV-002 (service token swap due to permissive role assumption). Repro steps attached in the report. Short-term mitigation: restrict Decrypt to resource-level ARNs and revoke the IAM permission from the worker role.

lee: +1 to restrictions. For the readroom we should pre-generate ephemeral creds and host a small artifact bundle for the assessors. Also need to confirm which keys we rotate vs rebind. Important: do not rotate the primary customer-provisioned key during business hours.

maria: Good notes. Proposed plan: 1) Create KMS proxy (read-only audit path) in staging, 2) Apply RBAC tightening to the affected roles in a canary namespace, 3) Package evidence (logs + policy diffs + presigned artifact), 4) Open a 4-hour readroom for the assessor retest. Proposed windows: Tue 2026-02-17 02:00-06:00 UTC or Thu 2026-02-19 22:00-02:00 UTC. Prefer Tue. @nina-qa can you lead the verification checklist?

nina-qa: I can own the verification. Will build a small prompt-driven regression harness and a set of 12 smoke cases. Need the exact policy diffs and the KMS proxy endpoint. Also: what's our log retention slice for the readroom? We need at least 7 days of fine-grain audit.

sanjay: For audit logging, enable: CloudAudit -> detailed, and ship a 1:1 stream to the secure SIEM index for the readroom window. Make sure we capture KMS:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, sts:AssumeRole events. Example KMS proxy snippet (staging):

```
# simple proxy config (nginx + signed path)
location /kms-proxy/ {
  proxy_pass http://kms-stub.internal;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
  # enforce caller-id header from auth layer
  proxy_set_header X-Caller-Id $http_x_caller_id;
}
```

sanjay: Also recommend marking the keys with a temporary tag `pt:locked=true` during readroom to flag them in telemetry.

jordan: For remediation tracking, I'm creating a single-sheet tracker with columns: finding_id, component, mitigation_pr, evidence_link, owner, target_for_retest. I'll link it once created. Let's keep PRs small (policy-only diffs) so we can parallelize reviews.

maria: Please make PRs against `canary/rbac-tighten` and `staging/kms-proxy`. Ops: tag the deploy with `pt-dryrun:<thread_ts>` so we can filter traces.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled: deployment to staging (kms-proxy) at 2026-02-16T23:30:00Z. No production changes.

jordan: Quick triage decisions for retest acceptance criteria: (A) Policy diff applied and logged; (B) No successful cross-account Decrypt in logs for 2 hours after deploy; (C) Smoke harness passes. If all true, mark finding LATERAL-001 as remediated for retest.

lee: One ops caveat: if the proxy introduces latency > 150ms for crypto ops we should failover to a read-only replica path and notify assessor. We'll script a graceful fallback and include details in the runbook.

maria: Volunteers so far: jordan (mitigation PR + tracker), nina-qa (verification harness), lee (readroom ops + fallback), sanjay (logging + SIEM pipeline), i'll shepherd the retest scheduling and evidence handoff to the assessor. I'll create the artifact bucket and presigned link and post in this thread when ready.

jordan: I'll open the tracker now: https://docs.internal/redwood/pt-tracker/LATERAL-ELEV-4310009999 (private link). Adding owners and target retest date Tue 2026-02-17.

maria: Thanks all. Action items summarized: - jordan: open mitigation PRs (canary) - lee: prepare proxy + fallback script - sanjay: enable detailed audit + tag keys - nina-qa: build harness + smoke cases - maria: create artifact bucket + presigned link + schedule readroom. Will ping ops-sre and legal for the evidence-handshake.

nina-qa: Quick question — do we want to include a seeded false-positive test for ELEV-002 checks so assessor can validate detection? Could be useful to prove regression coverage.

maria: Good idea. Add one seeded case but mark it clearly in the artifact manifest. We'll timestamp it and keep it separate from production logs.

jordan: All right, pushing the first PRs now. I'll post links + the tracker updates in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: Closing loop for now. Expect more granular check-ins tomorrow. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here or DM me.
